name: Presto USDC Vault
description: The Presto USDC Vault pursues optimal yield through a barbell strategy: a liquid core allocated to Presto's Morpho vaults, complemented by tactical positions in off-market opportunities such as warehousing facilities (Liquid Lane, 3F). Each opportunistic deal is underwritten and sized by Presto's risk assessment, keeping the portfolio anchored in liquid lending while selectively harvesting premia unavailable in public markets.
